product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity intelligence and compliance software that helps global enterprises analyze, remediate, and prevent pay inequities and meet pay-transparency requirements.

pricing_page.notes: The public site directs prospects to contact the company for a tailored walkthrough rather than exposing a pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 122 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog is a marketing/content blog; the technical AI material found is a lone post by the CEO, not two engineer-authored build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Trust Center lists multiple product/security documents, including integration and SSO setup guides, plus policy and compliance documents.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current readable openings include marketing and SDR roles; no AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, NLP, LLM, computer-vision, or scientist title was found.

model_provider.notes: Trusaic describes proprietary AI trained on its methodology and says data is not shared with public LLMs, but does not name a model or provider.

last_funding.notes: Dealroom reports no known external funding; a 2024 interview quotes the owner saying Trusaic is privately owned, debt-free, and has taken no outside funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The available funding history establishes no outside funding, so there is no round in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Readable current postings include Sales Development Representative and Global Enterprise Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Trusaic announced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive Monitor with an interactive map on 2026-05-20, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jeffery Small publicly announced joining Trusaic as Vice President of Partnerships on 2025-09-16, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.
